page: Amazon Web Services r8ib.48xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. Powered by 64-bit x86 Intel processors running at 3.9 GHz, the instance delivers 192 dedicated virtual CPUs across 96 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The platform supplies 1536.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Network performance is a focal component of the configuration, offering 200 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth to support high-throughput cluster communication and distributed processing. The instance does not include integrated local NVMe storage, meaning all data persistence and disk I/O must be provisioned through network-attached storage volumes. Hardware acceleration is absent, with zero GPUs included.

From an infrastructure efficiency standpoint, r8ib.48xlarge consolidates extensive memory arrays and substantial vCPU capacity onto a single host node, reducing inter-node networking overhead for monolithic data architectures. The absence of local disk drives requires consideration of remote volume latency for disk-bound operations. The instance is structured for large in-memory databases, distributed caching clusters, real-time data analytics, and enterprise memory-intensive workloads.
